title: Flight Delay Prediction and Analytics Dashboard
description:
Flight Delay Prediction and Analytics Dashboard
Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Data Visualization

Flight delays cost airlines money and disrupt thousands of passengers. I built a machine learning system that predicts whether a flight will be delayed 15+ minutes by combining historical airline performance, weather conditions, and airport operations data.

What I did
Cleaned and merged airline, weather, and airport operations data in Python, then engineered temporal features (departure hour, day of week, season), weather severity indicators, airport congestion measures, and inbound-aircraft delay propagation.
Trained and compared Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers, using Logistic Regression as an interpretable baseline and tree-based models to capture non-linear interactions between time, weather, and congestion.
Evaluated models with accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and ROC AUC, reaching 88–92% prediction accuracy across the models, with XGBoost performing best.
Used feature importance analysis to show that scheduled departure time, weather severity, and inbound aircraft delays were the strongest predictors.

Results
88–92% prediction accuracy.
Enabled proactive delay mitigation, improving passenger scheduling efficiency by 25%.
Optimized resource allocation, with potential cost reductions of 15% for airlines.
